spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
    host_group,
    COUNT(*) as unique_host_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        host,
        CASE 
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-SGP-C%' THEN 'TA-SGP-C'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-TKY-A%' THEN 'TA-TKY-A'           
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-TKY-C%' THEN 'TA-TKY-C'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-NVA%' THEN 'TA-NVA'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-IRL%' THEN 'TA-IRL'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-FRA%' THEN 'TA-FRA'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-SEO%' THEN 'TA-SEO'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-LDN%' THEN 'TA-LDN'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-OHI%' THEN 'TA-OHI'
            WHEN host LIKE 'AC-HKG%' THEN 'AC-HKG'            
            WHEN host LIKE '%DEV%' THEN 'DEV'
            ELSE 'OTHER'
        END as host_group
    FROM ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb
    WHERE
    timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)

GROUP BY host_group;

SELECT 
    host_group,
    COUNT(*) as unique_host_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        host,
        CASE 
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-SGP-C%' THEN 'TA-SGP-C'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-TKY-A%' THEN 'TA-TKY-A'           
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-TKY-C%' THEN 'TA-TKY-C'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-NVA%' THEN 'TA-NVA'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-IRL%' THEN 'TA-IRL'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-FRA%' THEN 'TA-FRA'
            WHEN host LIKE 'TA-SEO%' THEN 'TA-SEO'
            ELSE 'OTHER'
        END as host_group
    FROM ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb
)
GROUP BY host_group;
SELECT DISTINCT host FROM ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb;

spec.title: Count of Hosts - Reporting to ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
AS unique_host_count 
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT host 
  FROM ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb
  WHERE
    timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  );

SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    avg(drop) AS M_DROP,
    host AS H,
    process AS P,
FROM ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb
WHERE
    timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND host = '$host' 
SAMPLE BY 1m;

SELECT 
    timestamp AS time,
    avg(drop) AS mean_drop,
    host,
    process,
    pid,
    localport,
    localaddr
FROM ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb
WHERE
    timestamp BETWEEN '2024-11-07T09:44:00Z' AND '2024-11-07T10:44:00Z'
GROUP BY timestamp, host, process, pid, localport, localaddr
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    avg(drop) AS M_DROP,
    host AS H,
    process AS P,
    pid AS PID,
    localport AS LP,
    localaddr AS LA
FROM ss_tcp_net_mon_v3_qdb
WHERE
    timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND host = $host
SAMPLE BY 1m;

    "host"
